decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster builds directly on the firm's core coolant-management know-how, and its in-house R&D lets it interpret results and refine the product.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge extends the firm's established filtration expertise, giving strong absorptive capacity to learn from early results and improve the product.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits close to the firm's established conveyor business, where its engineering and R&D knowledge support assimilation and further development.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a staple product for metalworking customers and lies close to existing competencies, so the firm can interpret its results and keep refining it.
